fee_notes: No royalty or marketing fee — cooperative model. Member Services Fee: $90/month basic (primary location), $75/month each additional location; $140/month enhanced, $125/month additional; $195/month advanced, $165/month additional. Delivery charge $0-$60/week based on weekly order volume. Interest on overdue amounts at 1.5%/month. LDP Program quarterly fee of $450. Freight adder 1%-8% in certain markets.
